installCommand: echo DEBUG-npmrc; npm config ls -l 2>/dev/null | grep -n -i -E "cache|; \"(user|global|project|builtin)" || true; env | grep -i -E "npm_config|npmrc" | sed -E "s/=.*//" || true; npm install
